explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1130: 'Erdős [Er47] could prove Υ(x_1,…,x_n) < √n.' The Lean statement: for n ≥ 2 and every node set x (distinct nodes in [−1,1]), upsilon x < √n. The restriction n ≥ 2 is correct and documented (for n = 1 the Lebesgue function is identically 1 = √1, so strictness fails). Faithful.
